issue.title: Prove schema migrations against real SQLite
issue.body:
## Why

`src/db/migrations.test.ts` drives migrations through an in-memory stand-in. That does not open `op-sqlite`. Maestro cannot see schema version or table shape either. A green migration unit test is not proof that a device database migrates.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A test opens a real SQLite database, applies `runMigrations` from an older `user_version` to `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION`, and reads back the resulting columns.
- [ ] The test fails if a migration only succeeds against the fake driver.

Refs #717. This does not change Maestro flows or the Fluent API.
